vocabulary.definition: related to existence, especially human existence and the meaning of life
vocabulary.example: The protagonist in the novel faces an existential crisis, questioning the purpose of their life.

vocabulary.definition: a feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder
vocabulary.example: Standing on top of the mountain, she gazed in awe at the breathtaking view below.

vocabulary.definition: a belief that life is meaningless and rejects all religious and moral principles
vocabulary.example: The character in the play adopted a nihilistic attitude towards society's values.

vocabulary.definition: an imagined place or state of things where everything is perfect
vocabulary.example: The novel depicts a utopia where all inhabitants live in harmony and abundance.

vocabulary.definition: the state of being aware of and able to think about one's surroundings
vocabulary.example: After the accident, he regained consciousness in the hospital.

vocabulary.definition: relating to a galaxy, especially the Milky Way galaxy
vocabulary.example: The space explorers embarked on a mission to study galactic phenomena beyond our solar system.
